Type help to see all commands


Memo supports Markdown, click ✏️ to edit
help_text:
📌 Available Commands:
open <url> [-t] — Open a URL (-t new tab)
search -s <engine> — Set default search engine (google/baidu/bing/duckduckgo)
search <keywords> [by <engine>] [-t] — Search with default or specified engine, -t new tab
link list — List all saved links
link add <name> <url> — Add a new link
link remove <name> — Remove a link
go <name> [-t] — Open a saved link (-t new tab)
export links — Export links as JSON
bg set <image-url> — Set web background image
bg pick — Pick local image as background
bg reset — Reset to current theme default background
bg remove — Remove background image, keep theme gradient
theme list — List all available themes
theme set <name> — Switch theme (ubuntu/kali/deepin/debian/uos/kylin)
font size <number> — Change font size (px)
history clear — Clear command history
memo — Show memo
memo set <content> — Set memo content (supports quotes)
memo append <content> — Append to memo
memo clear — Clear memo
clear — Clear screen
lang list — List all languages
lang set <code> — Switch language
lang install <URL> — Install language pack from URL
lang pick — Install language pack from local file
lang remove <code> — Remove language pack
